March

Turn it back on without breaking anything.

Spring start-up means more than flipping a switch. We pressurize slowly, check every zone for freeze damage, set your controller to McKinney watering days, and leave you a card with your schedule.

  • Spring start-up. System turned back on, every zone checked, and the schedule set for your watering days.
  • Smart controller setup. Controller programmed to your city's watering days and changed when the rules change.
  • Rain and freeze sensors. A sensor that stops the system from running in rain or on near-freezing mornings.
Book start-up

Dry spots, geysers and bills that jumped overnight — we find the leak, fix the zone, and show you what broke before we close the trench.

November

Shut it down before the first hard freeze.

Winterization in North Texas isn't optional. We shut the water off, drain the backflow, wrap it, and tag the valve box so spring start-up is clean.

  • Winterization. Water shut off, backflow drained and wrapped before the first North Texas freeze.
  • Backflow testing. Yearly backflow test sent to your city, plus repair if the device fails.
Book winterization

February

The freeze splits pipes. We replace them fast.

After a hard freeze, backflow devices crack and lateral lines split. We carry the common sizes on the truck and finish most freeze repairs in one visit.

Freeze-ready checklist

  • Backflow wrapped or insulated
  • Main shut-off tagged and working
  • Controller set to off or rain mode
  • Drip zones drained or capped

Book freeze repair
